caged.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人说那只鸟怎么样？
caged.why: caged bird 关在笼中的鸟。

caged.stem: The ______ bird looked sad in the small cage.
caged.why: 修饰名词 bird 用形容词 caged（关在笼中的）。

caged.ask: 从 caged、cage 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
caged.stem: The lion was kept in a ______ at the zoo.
caged.why: in a cage 在笼子里，用名词 cage。

caged.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
caged.why: 修饰 animals 用形容词 caged。

caged.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
caged.stem: The caged bird sing every morning.
caged.why: 主语 The caged bird 是单数，一般现在时用 sings。

caged.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
caged.zh: 关在笼中的动物失去了自由。
caged.why: 句首用 Caged，关在笼中的。

caged.stem: We saw a ______ bird at the pet shop yesterday.
caged.why: 修饰名词 bird 用形容词 caged。

lane.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人住在哪里？
lane.listen: They live on a quiet lane near the park.
lane.why: quiet lane 是安静的小巷。

lane.stem: There are two ______ on this road, so cars can pass easily.

lane.ask: 从 lane、alley 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
lane.stem: The cat ran into a narrow ______ between the two buildings.
lane.why: 楼房之间的小巷用 alley。

lane.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
lane.stem: The old town has many small ______. (lane)

lane.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
lane.stem: Please stay in your lane and mind your own business.
lane.why: stay in your lane 是固定短语，lane 用单数。

lane.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
lane.zh: 这条小路很窄，只能走一个人。

lane.stem: The bike ______ is on the left of the road.
lane.why: bike lane 自行车道，用单数 lane。

crafty.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人觉得那个人怎么样？
crafty.listen: The man was too crafty to trust.
crafty.why: crafty 狡猾的，too crafty to trust 太狡猾不能信。

crafty.stem: The fox in the story is very ______.
crafty.why: 作表语说“狡猾的”用形容词 crafty。

crafty.ask: 从 crafty、cunning 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
crafty.stem: He is a ______ old man who always plans ahead.
crafty.why: crafty 重手法巧妙、老谋深算；这里说会算计、会钻空子用 cunning。

crafty.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
crafty.stem: This old fox is even ______ than the one in the story. (crafty)
crafty.why: even 后面用比较级，crafty 变 y 为 i 加 er。

crafty.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
crafty.stem: The crafty fox tricked the crow and got the meat.
crafty.why: crafty 拼写正确，y 前是辅音字母，比较级才变 i。

crafty.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
crafty.zh: 这个狡猾的商人骗了所有人。
crafty.why: 修饰名词“商人”用形容词 crafty。

crafty.stem: He is good with his hands and makes beautiful chairs. We say he is ______.
crafty.kd: 夸人手巧用 skilful，crafty 是贬义“狡猾的”。

craftsmanship.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人在夸什么？
craftsmanship.listen: The craftsmanship of this old chair is wonderful.

craftsmanship.stem: The ______ of this watch is excellent.
craftsmanship.kd: the … of 后面要名词 craftsmanship（做工）。

craftsmanship.ask: 从 craftsmanship、workmanship 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
craftsmanship.stem: The table broke easily because of poor ______.
craftsmanship.why: workmanship 更中性，可说 poor workmanship 做工粗糙；craftsmanship 多褒义。

craftsmanship.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
craftsmanship.stem: The ______ in this factory make shoes by hand. (craftsmanship)
craftsmanship.why: 说“工匠们”用复数 craftsmen，craftsmanship 是不可数名词。

craftsmanship.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
craftsmanship.stem: This old bridge shows the great craftsmanship of the workers.
craftsmanship.why: craftsmanship 不可数，没有复数，这里用法正确。

craftsmanship.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
craftsmanship.zh: 这把椅子的做工非常好。
craftsmanship.stem: The ______ of this chair is very good.
We all admire the ______ of these hand-made bags.
craftsmanship.kd: the … of 结构要名词 craftsmanship（工艺水准）。

craftsman.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人是什么人？
craftsman.listen: My uncle is a craftsman who makes wooden toys.

craftsman.stem: These ______ make beautiful paper flowers by hand.
craftsman.kd: These 后面用复数 craftsmen（man 变 men）。

craftsman.ask: 从 craftsman、worker 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
craftsman.stem: The ______ in this shop makes fine chairs by hand.
craftsman.why: craftsman 重“手艺好”；worker 只说干活的人。

craftsman.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
craftsman.stem: My grandfather is a famous ______ in our town. (craftsman)

craftsman.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
craftsman.stem: Two craftsman are making a big wooden ship.

craftsman.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
craftsman.zh: 这些工匠做的鞋子很受欢迎。
craftsman.stem: The shoes made by these ______ are very popular.
He is a skilled ______ and his work is always fine.
craftsman.why: 说“手艺好的工匠”用 craftsman。

craftsmen.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人认为这些工匠怎么样？
craftsmen.why: craftsmen 是“工匠们”，他们做漂亮的椅子。
These 后面接复数 craftsmen（工匠们）。

craftsmen.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
craftsmen.stem: The craftsmen in this village is very old.
craftsmen.why: 主语 craftsmen 是复数，be 动词用 are。

craftsmen.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
craftsmen.zh: 这些工匠们工作非常努力。

craftsmen.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
craftsmen.stem: A ______ made this old table by hand. (craftsmen)
craftsmen.why: A 后面接单数 craftsman（工匠）。

craftsmen.stem: Many ______ work in this small town.

craftsmen.ask: 从 craftsmen、craftsman 中选一个，用适当形式填空。

craftsperson.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人想成为什么？
craftsperson.listen: She wants to be a craftsperson when she grows up.

craftsperson.stem: Two ______ are making a wooden boat.

craftsperson.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
craftsperson.stem: A craftsperson make things with their hands.
craftsperson.why: 主语 A craftsperson 是单数，动词用 makes。

craftsperson.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
craftsperson.zh: 这位手艺人做的包很漂亮。

craftsperson.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
craftsperson.stem: Many ______ sell their work at the market. (craftsperson)
A ______ uses hands and tools to make things.

craftsperson.ask: 从 craftsperson、artisan 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
craftsperson.stem: The old ______ in the village makes paper flowers.
craftsperson.why: 单数主语用 craftsperson；artisan 也可，但本词是 craftsperson。

handicraft.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人喜欢什么？

handicraft.stem: Paper cutting is a famous Chinese ______.
handicraft.why: a 后面接单数名词 handicraft（手工艺）。

handicraft.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
handicraft.stem: This bag is handicraft by my mother.
handicraft.why: “手工制作的”是形容词 handmade，作表语。

handicraft.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
handicraft.zh: 这家店卖各种手工艺品。
handicraft.stem: The shop sells many kinds of ______.

handicraft.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
handicraft.stem: These ______ are made by local people. (handicraft)

handicraft.ask: 从 handicraft、handmade 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
handicraft.stem: My sister bought a ______ bag yesterday.
handicraft.why: 修饰名词 bag 用形容词 handmade（手工制作的）。

handicraft.stem: Learning ______ takes a lot of time.
handicraft.why: Learning 后面接名词 handicraft（手工艺）。

craftspeople.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人说的是什么人？
craftspeople.listen: The craftspeople make beautiful chairs by hand.

craftspeople.stem: Many ______ work in this old street every day.

craftspeople.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
craftspeople.stem: The craftsman are very busy today.
craftspeople.why: are 前面要用复数 craftspeople。

craftspeople.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
从 craftspeople、craftwork 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
craftspeople.stem: The ______ in this village are famous.
craftspeople.why: are 前面要复数人 craftspeople。

craftspeople.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
craftspeople.zh: 这些手艺人每天做漂亮的椅子。
craftspeople.stem: These ______ make beautiful chairs every day.
We met three ______ at the art show yesterday.

craftswoman.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人说的是谁？
craftswoman.listen: The craftswoman made this small box last week.

craftswoman.stem: The ______ made a beautiful bag yesterday.

craftswoman.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
craftswoman.stem: The craftswoman are making a toy now.
craftswoman.why: craftswoman 是单数，be 动词用 is。

craftswoman.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
craftswoman.stem: That ______ is very good at making paper flowers. (craftswoman)

craftswoman.ask: 从 craftswoman、craftspeople 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
craftswoman.stem: The ______ in this shop is my aunt.

craftswoman.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
craftswoman.zh: 这位女手艺人昨天做了一个漂亮的包。
craftswoman.stem: This ______ made a beautiful bag yesterday.
Two ______ are working in the room now.

craftwork.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人喜欢什么？
craftwork.listen: My sister likes craftwork very much.

craftwork.stem: Paper cutting is a kind of Chinese ______.
craftwork.why: a kind of 后面接不可数名词 craftwork。

craftwork.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
craftwork.stem: She is interested in craftworks very much.
craftwork.why: craftwork 作“手工艺”讲不可数，不用复数。

craftwork.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
从 craftwork、handicraft 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
craftwork.why: craftwork 指手工艺；这里用 craftwork 更常见。

craftwork.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
craftwork.zh: 剪纸是一种中国手工艺。
craftwork.stem: Paper cutting is a kind of Chinese ______.
craftwork.why: a kind of 后面接不可数 craftwork。

craftwork.stem: Many people enjoy ______ in this club every Sunday.

slip.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人昨天怎么了？
slip.listen: I slipped on the wet floor yesterday.
slip.why: slip on the wet floor 在湿地板上滑倒。

slip.stem: Be careful, or you will ______ on the ice.
slip.why: 在冰上意外滑倒用 slip；slide 是平稳滑行。

slip.ask: 从 slip、slide 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
slip.stem: The children like to ______ down the hill on the snow.
slip.why: slide down 在表面上平稳地滑行；slip 是意外滑倒。

slip.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
slip.stem: He ______ on the wet road last night. (slip)
slip.why: 过去式双写 p 加 ed：slipped。

slip.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
slip.stem: She slips on the banana skin and fell down.
slip.why: and 后 fell 是过去式，前面也用过去式 slipped。

slip.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
slip.zh: 他正小心翼翼地走在结冰的路上，以免再次滑倒。
slip.stem: He is walking carefully on the icy road to avoid ______ again.
slip.why: avoid 后接动名词，slip 双写 p 加 ing。

slip.stem: Don't ______ up on such a small thing.
slip.why: slip up 是固定短语，意为“疏忽出错”。

slippery.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人说路怎么样？
slippery.listen: The road is very slippery after the rain.

slippery.stem: Be careful! The floor is ______ after the rain.
slippery.why: be 后接形容词 slippery（滑的）。

slippery.ask: 从 slippery、slip 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
slippery.stem: The wet floor is very ______, so walk slowly.
slippery.why: 系动词 is 后要用形容词 slippery。

slippery.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
slippery.stem: The fish is too ______ to hold in my hand. (slip)
slippery.why: too … to 结构中用形容词 slippery（滑的）。

slippery.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
slippery.stem: The stone is very slipperyly after the rain.
slippery.why: be 后接形容词，不用副词。

slippery.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
slippery.zh: 这条路又湿又滑，我们慢点走。
slippery.stem: The road is wet and ______, so let's walk slowly.
slippery.why: 形容词作表语，意为“滑的”。

slippery.stem: Learning to lie is a ______ slope to bad habits.
slippery.why: slippery slope 是固定搭配，比喻“滑坡”。

sparkle.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人说什么在阳光下闪闪发光？
sparkle.listen: The water in the lake sparkled in the sun.
opts: 湖水在阳光下闪闪发光
sparkle.why: sparkle 指连续的细碎闪光。

sparkle.stem: The stars ______ in the night sky.
sparkle.why: 星星一明一暗地“眨”用 twinkle，不用 sparkle。

sparkle.ask: 从 sparkle、glitter 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
sparkle.stem: Her dress was covered with ______ that caught the light.
sparkle.why: 亮片、金属那种耀眼闪光用 glitter。

sparkle.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
sparkle.stem: The diamond ______ brightly under the light last night. (sparkle)
sparkle.why: last night 是过去时间，动词用过去式 sparkled（去 e 加 d）。

sparkle.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
sparkle.stem: The Christmas lights sparkle all night long every year.
sparkle.why: 句子没有错误，every year 表示习惯，主语 lights 是复数，用原形 sparkle。

sparkle.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
sparkle.zh: 她笑起来时，眼睛闪闪发光。
sparkle.why: 主语 eyes 是复数，一般现在时用原形 sparkle。

sparkle.stem: The ______ water made the party feel lively.
sparkle.why: 修饰名词 water 要用现在分词 sparkling 作形容词。

sparkly.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人在形容什么？
sparkly.listen: She wore a sparkly dress to the party.
sparkly.why: sparkly 形容衣服上闪闪发光的亮片。

sparkly.stem: Her ______ earrings caught everyone's eye at the party.
sparkly.why: 修饰名词 earrings 要用形容词 sparkly（亮晶晶的）。

sparkly.ask: 从 sparkly、sparkling 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
sparkly.stem: We drank ______ wine at the celebration.
sparkly.why: 说饮料“起泡的”用 sparkling，不用 sparkly。

sparkly.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
sparkly.stem: This dress is ______ than that one. (sparkly)
sparkly.why: 比较级要把 y 变 i 再加 er，用 sparklier。

sparkly.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
sparkly.stem: She likes to wear sparkly things, such as shining rings and bright necklaces.
sparkly.why: 句子没有错误，sparkly 作形容词修饰 things。

sparkly.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
sparkly.zh: 这是店里最亮晶晶的一顶帽子。
sparkly.stem: This is the ______ hat in the shop.
sparkly.why: 最高级要把 y 变 i 再加 est，用 sparkliest。

sparkly.stem: The ______ stars made the night sky look beautiful.
sparkly.why: 修饰名词 stars 要用形容词 sparkly。

salty.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人觉得汤怎么样？
salty.listen: This soup is too salty for me.

salty.stem: This dish is ______ than that one.
salty.why: than 前用比较级，salty 变 y 为 i 加 er。

salty.ask: 从 salty、salt 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
salty.stem: The water in the sea is ______.
salty.why: 说味道咸日常用 salty，salt 只用于固定搭配。

salty.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
salty.stem: Of all the soups, this one is the ______. (salty)
salty.why: the 后、范围 of all 中用最高级 saltiest。

salty.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
salty.stem: The fish tastes too much salty.
salty.why: taste 后接形容词，不用 much 修饰。

salty.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
salty.why: a little 修饰形容词 salty。

salty.stem: The soup tastes ______. Please add some water.
salty.why: taste 后接形容词，这里说“咸的”用原级 salty。

saltwater.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人在说什么水？

saltwater.stem: This kind of fish lives in ______, not in fresh water.
saltwater.why: 修饰 water 说海水用 saltwater。

saltwater.ask: 从 saltwater、freshwater 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
saltwater.why: 与 saltwater 相对的是 freshwater 淡水。

saltwater.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
saltwater.stem: Many sea animals live in the saltwaters.

saltwater.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。

saltwater.stem: We should not drink ______ because it is too salty.
saltwater.why: 海水太咸不能喝，用 saltwater。

salty-tasting.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人觉得汤怎么样？
salty-tasting.why: salty-tasting 意思是吃起来发咸的。

salty-tasting.stem: The soup is ______, so please add some water.
salty-tasting.why: 作表语说“吃起来咸的”用 salty-tasting。

salty-tasting.ask: 从 salty-tasting、salt 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
salty-tasting.stem: This dish is too ______ for me.
salty-tasting.why: 说食物吃起来咸用 salty-tasting；salt 是名词“盐”。

salty-tasting.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
salty-tasting.stem: The fish is ______ because there is too much salt. (salty-tasting)
salty-tasting.why: be 后面用形容词 salty-tasting 作表语。

salty-tasting.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
salty-tasting.why: “吃起来咸的”正确写法是 salty-tasting。

salty-tasting.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
salty-tasting.why: taste 作系动词，主语单数用 tastes。

salty-tasting.stem: The noodles are ______, so I want some water.
salty-tasting.why: 作表语说“吃起来咸的”用 salty-tasting。
